findings.title: Command Execution Hijack on Windows with Process class
findings.description: On Windows, if cmd.exe exists in the CWD, the Symfony Process class may call it instead of the system cmd.exe, enabling command execution hijacking.

validation: Run trivy fs --scanners vuln . to verify CVE is absent

findings.title: Environment Variable Injection via register_argc_argv
findings.description: When register_argc_argv is enabled, a crafted query string can override APP_ENV and other environment-driven behaviors.

remediation.action: Update laravel/framework to ^10.48.23 and set register_argc_argv=Off in php.ini

findings.title: Denial of Service via Quadratic Complexity
findings.description: Polynomial time complexity issues allow crafted Markdown input to cause unbounded resource exhaustion (DoS).

remediation.action: Update league/commonmark to ^2.8.1 (also resolves CVE-2025-46734 and CVE-2026-30838)

findings.title: Improper Inheritance of Trusted Request Headers
findings.description: The Request class improperly inherits trusted headers from the client, enabling IP spoofing and HTTPS detection bypass.

findings.cvss_score_note: Vendor-rated MEDIUM despite high CVSS — requires specific wildcard validation usage
findings.title: Wildcard Validation Bypass for File Uploads
findings.description: Crafted requests can bypass wildcard file/image validation rules (files.*), potentially allowing unauthorized file type uploads.

remediation.command: Included in laravel/framework update (composer update laravel/framework)

findings.title: XSS in Attributes Extension
findings.description: Remote attackers can inject malicious JavaScript via the Attributes extension. Resolved by updating to 2.8.1+.

findings.title: DisallowedRawHtml Extension Bypass via Whitespace
findings.description: Inserting whitespace between HTML tag name and '>' bypasses the DisallowedRawHtml filter, allowing <script\n> to render unfiltered.

findings.title: Arbitrary File Include via Carbon::setLocale()
findings.description: Unsanitized user input passed to Carbon::setLocale() can trigger arbitrary file inclusion if PHP files are uploadable.

findings.title: Local Privilege Escalation via CWD .psysh.php Auto-Load
findings.description: PsySH auto-loads .psysh.php from CWD; attacker-controlled CWD content executes when developer runs php artisan tinker.

findings.title: URI Parsing Inconsistency Enabling Validator Bypass
findings.description: The Request class parses URIs with special characters differently from browsers, enabling bypass of URI-based access controls.

findings.title: Hardcoded Bcrypt Hash in Test Factory (Likely False Positive)
findings.description: Standard Laravel test factory placeholder hash detected. Not a production credential. Likely false positive.

remediation.action: Replace hardcoded hash with bcrypt('password') or Hash::make('password')
validation: Re-run semgrep scan to confirm finding resolved
